items.title: Illumina (ILMN) Unveils Duplex Sequencing Workflow For MRD Research

items.title: Illumina (ILMN) Selected For Singapore Genome Sequencing Program Covering 450,000 People
items.summary: Illumina (NasdaqGS:ILMN) has been chosen to perform whole genome sequencing for Singapore's SG-INSIGHT study under National Precision Medicine Phase III. The SG-INSIGHT project targets around 450,000 people, covering roughly one in ten residents of Singapore. The program expands Illumina's earlier work in Singapore from healthy volunteers into broader clinical applications within the public health system.
